description: This file defines a PHP class `delete_project_tasks` that handles deleting related project tasks when a project is deleted. It includes methods to retrieve and mark tasks as deleted in the database.

classes.name: delete_project_tasks
classes.description: A class responsible for deleting tasks associated with a project when the project is deleted.

methods.name: delete_tasks
methods.description: Deletes all tasks associated with the given project bean by marking them as deleted in the database.
